Shreyas Kota / Aerospace Engineer

Who is
Shreyas?

I'm an aerospace engineer who's spent the last few years designing things built to survive extreme stress — composite rocket bodies, cryogenic hydrogen tanks. Today, I'm working on hydrogen tank structures at Lufthansa Technik, while still making time to work on myself, hit the trails, or lose a weekend to a good book.
